text: dsh-token-heatmap 是面向 DSH 网页设置页的每日 Token 用量热力图插件。它将组件注册到设置页区块，并从 DSH 本机的会话日志生成统计。用户可查看半年或一年的每日、每周用量，切换总量、输入与输出、缓存读取或输出指标，并展开单日 Token 构成与按 DeepSeek 价目估算的人民币费用。适合想从本地会话记录了解用量变化的 DSH 用户；无需 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-token-heatmap adds a daily usage heatmap to DSH web settings, aggregating local session logs. View six months or a year by day or week, filter token metrics, and open daily breakdowns with estimated CNY costs based on DeepSeek prices. No API key or external account is needed.
想在 DSH 设置里按天查看 Token 用量变化。
帮我从本地会话日志汇总每日 Token 数和大致费用。
Show me a weekly view of my DSH token usage from local session logs.
dsh-token-heatmap 的功能「每日与每周用量热力图」：在 DSH 设置页显示半年或一年的 Token 用量网格，可切换日/周视图及总量、输入输出、缓存读取和输出指标；选择日期可查看当天统计。
dsh-token-heatmap 的功能「单日明细与费用估算」：选择热力图日期后显示输入、输出、缓存读取等 Token 构成和估算 CNY 费用；费用按日志记录时间及 DeepSeek 价目计算。

dsh-token-heatmap README · dsh-token-heatmap：[中文](README.zh.md) | English

A **daily token-usage heatmap** that adds a "Token usage" section to the DSH settings page. One cell per day; theme-aware greyscale indicates relative usage.

Selecting a day also shows an **estimated cost in CNY**, derived from DeepSeek's published list prices and their peak/off-peak schedule.

All data is derived from DSH's own local session logs. **No external network requests and no separate usage ledger.**

dsh-token-heatmap README · dsh-token-heatmap：> **Privacy**: this plugin makes no outbound requests. Session logs are read on the local machine only, and the aggregated result is served to your local DSH page. The repository contains no personal data or credentials.

dsh-token-heatmap README · Design highlights：- **A native settings section, not an overlay.** The component registers into the `settings.section` slot and renders React elements only. It does not append to `document.body`, does not replace the application root, and imports no Harness client package. It therefore occupies the settings sidebar alongside the built-in sections rather than floating above the application. See [Implementation notes](#implementation-notes).
- **Local data only, single source of truth.** No data leaves the machine and no additional ledger is required: every figure is derived from the session logs DSH already writes.
- **The session log format is parsed explicitly.** Concatenated zstd frames, replayed `seq` values and truncated tail frames are each handled as distinct cases. A single-pass decompression retains only the first frame of a multi-frame log and therefore under-reports usage. See [Data source](#data-source).
- **Colour levels remain readable at both ends of the scale.** The four metrics differ by orders of magnitude, so levels are derived from **quantiles of the local data set** (25th/50th/75th percentiles) rather than fixed thresholds. Cache reads

dsh-token-heatmap README · Half-year heatmap and compact tooltip：Open Settings → **Token usage**. The default range is six months. Choose total, input+output, cache read or output, and switch between daily and weekly views. The range selector offers six months or a full year; the year is split into two rows.

dsh-token-heatmap README · Half-year heatmap and compact tooltip：Hover a date cell to display three lines: the date (YYYY-MM-DD), the selected metric's Token count, and “Click to view details”. The example below shows 2026-10-13 with a total of 117,405,946 Token. Selecting the cell displays that day's breakdown below the heatmap. The outline indicates hover or selection; today's cell has no default highlight. Cells with no recorded usage remain at the dimmest level, so the brightness range is reserved for days with usage.

dsh-token-heatmap README · Inline daily details and Token composition：Selecting a date displays its details inline below the heatmap, without navigating away from the page. A single-line hint above the footnote indicates the interaction until a date is selected. Selecting the same date again collapses the detail body while retaining the selection outline on the heatmap, so the selected date remains identifiable; the collapsed row provides an expand control. For keyboard users, `Esc` on a focused cell collapses the details, and a second press clears the selection. All filters remain available throughout.

text: dsh-token-heatmap README · Chinese interface：Labels, months, dates and number units follow the host language. The same daily total appears as “1.17 亿” in Chinese and “117.41M” in English.

dsh-token-heatmap README · Features：- Default half-year range (26 weeks); full year uses two rows (27 + 26 weeks), each with month labels
- Cells capped at 20px with 4px gaps, sized to the container to avoid horizontal scrollbars
- **Daily / Weekly** views: daily levels or one shared level per natural week; Sunday–Saturday, future dates empty
- **Four metrics**: total / input+output / cache read / output, rendered in theme-aware grayscale
- Hover or focus shows the cell's date, the selected metric's Token count and a click hint; weekly counts are labeled
- Click a date for inline daily details below the heatmap: total, input, output, cache reads, calls, nonzero cache writes, and an estimated cost in CNY; weekly cells open their actual day
- Selecting the selected date again collapses the detail body while retaining its selection outline; an expand control and `Esc` both collapse, and selecting another date switches without an intermediate collapse
- **Cost estimate** based on DeepSeek's published CNY prices, including the peak/off-peak schedule applied per record timestamp; unknown models fall back to the Flash table and are labelled as such. The English interface writes `CNY ¥4.98

dsh-token-heatmap README · Data source：`<DSH_HOME>/sessions/<project>/<session>/session.v*.jsonl.zstd`

The plugin reads log records containing a valid timestamp and `data.usage`:

```
inputTokens / outputTokens / cacheReadTokens / cacheWriteTokens / totalTokens
```

plus `time` (epoch milliseconds) and `data.message.source.model`. Bucketing those by local calendar day gives the daily totals.

Three details that must be handled correctly:

dsh-token-heatmap README · Data source：1. **Logs contain concatenated zstd frames** — the parser locates frame magic bytes and decompresses frames separately to retain readable frames.
2. **The same `seq` can appear more than once** (replay) — deduplicate by `seq`, otherwise a day gets inflated.
3. **A truncated frame can appear at the tail** while a session is being written — skip that frame only, never drop the whole file.

dsh-token-heatmap README · Data source：Parsed results are cached by file size, modification time and aggregation time zone. New or changed files, and files whose aggregation time zone has changed, are parsed again.

dsh-token-heatmap README · About the metrics：Total includes cache reads reported in the logs; their share depends on usage. Input+output counts only those two fields. DSH logs record token counts but no currency amounts, so the cost shown in the detail panel is an estimate computed by this plugin.

Colour buckets use **quantiles** (25th/50th/75th percentiles of the local data set) rather than absolute thresholds, so the chart remains readable even though the four metrics differ by orders of magnitude.

dsh-token-heatmap README · Cost estimate：Cost is computed per session-log record, because DeepSeek prices depend on the time of day:

```
cost = cacheReadTokens/1e6 × cacheHitPrice
     + inputTokens/1e6     × cacheMissPrice
     + outputTokens/1e6    × outputPrice
```

dsh-token-heatmap README · Cost estimate：- Prices are in CNY per million tokens. `deepseek-flash` uses 0.02 / 1 / 4 (off-peak) and 0.04 / 2 / 8 (peak); `deepseek-v4-pro` uses 0.15 / 4.5 / 13.5 and 0.3 / 9 / 27.
- Peak hours are 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time on weekdays. Weekends and PRC statutory holidays are always off-peak.
- Models not listed in the table fall back to the Flash prices; the detail panel names them so an assumption is visible.
- The figures are estimates, not a bill. The authoritative amount is the provider's billing record.
- **The billing currency is CNY, not the interface language.** DeepSeek bills in CNY and the price table is denominated in CNY, so the English interface prefixes the amount with `CNY` (for example `CNY ¥4.98`) rather than converting to USD. No exchange-rate conversion is applied.

dsh-token-heatmap README · Cost estimate：The table and the 2026 holiday list live in `lib/pricing.js` and must be updated when DeepSeek changes prices or when the State Council publishes the following year's holiday schedule.

dsh-token-heatmap README · Install：The desktop app's profile is managed exclusively by the app, and `dsh plugin` refuses to touch it, so install from inside the app:

1. Open DSH → sidebar **Plugins** → **Add plugin**
2. Enter the absolute path to this directory (the CLI form is `dsh plugin add "link:<path>"`)
3. Install, then restart the app
4. Open **Settings** — a "Token Usage" entry appears in the navigation

Uninstall: open the bundle's card on the same page → Uninstall.

dsh-token-heatmap README · Layout：Use a Node.js version supporting `node:zlib` / `zstdDecompressSync` (Node.js 24 recommended). Client and weekly tests need no session logs. `npm test` uses deterministic fixtures and host stubs. `npm run test:logs` reads local logs; set `DSH_SESSIONS_ROOT` to override the path.

Self-tests:

```bash
npm ci
npm run check
npm test
npm run test:logs

dsh-token-heatmap README · Layout：Formatting is defined by `.editorconfig` and Prettier. Run `npm run format` to format the repository and `npm run check` to check formatting and entry-point syntax. Prettier is a development dependency only.

dsh-token-heatmap README · Implementation notes：**The UI goes through a slot, it does not inject DOM.** The component registers into `settings.section` and only renders React elements. It imports no Harness client package and writes its own styles primarily using host theme tokens. (The DSH plugin guide explicitly forbids appending to `document.body` or replacing the app root.)

dsh-token-heatmap README · Implementation notes：**Adaptive sizing.** A `ResizeObserver` measures the container and computes each cell's edge length into the CSS variable `--dth-cell`. Sizing fits 26 columns for the half year and at most 27 columns per row for the year, capped at 20px and accounting for gaps and padding.

dsh-token-heatmap README · Implementation notes：**Week alignment.** The range starts 25 or 52 weeks before the Sunday of the current week, so every column is a complete natural week, and cells after today stay empty. Month labels are placed on columns containing the first day of a month, with an additional label at each row start.

dsh-token-heatmap README · Implementation notes：**Localization.** Visible text is never hardcoded. The plugin registers its own dictionary namespace with `ctx.locale.register(ns, { zh, en })` and reads it through the framework's injected `t` seat, so a language switch re-renders the section. Number units are localized too (`万/亿` in Chinese, `K/M/B` in English).

dsh-token-heatmap README · Implementation notes：Client checks execute `client.js` with React hook stubs, covering the first visible render, compact tooltips, inline details, range switching and composition. They do not replace layout, animation, focus or theme verification in DSH.
